newsitem.title: UK: Mirror bid for Midland referred to MMC.
newsitem.headline: Mirror bid for Midland referred to MMC.

text.p: The UK's Department of Trade and Industry said on Thursday that Mirror Group Plc's 297 million stg bid for Midland Independent News Plc has been referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC).

"Where an application is made to the Secretary of State for a transfer of this kind, as a general rule she is required by the Act to refer the matter to the MMC for investigation and report," the DTI said in a statement.

Under the Fair Trading Act 1973 the transfer of a newspaper to a proprietor whose daily circulation is more than 500,000 copies requires the written consent of the Trade and Industry Secretary Margaret Beckett and a reference to the MMC is required before consent is given.
The MMC has until September 24 to report its findings.
